answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by anchoring each identity to an external reputation vault it cannot cheaply forge. Admission requires a long-lived record, such as a code history or prior on-chain activity, verified by independent oracles. Like a sonnet, it must show sustained, coherent authorship, not copied lines. Anchors are rechecked each epoch; a transferred anchor revokes rights. An attacker must build or buy a credible history for every fake, paying months of real work per copy, while an umber shadow of cheap clones fails verification. Honest agents anchor once and earn.
